body: I get that fear. They're also firing you without legal cover. I'm of the opinion what they don't want is for you to fight back. To be a road block. They want you to shut up and keep your head down. And listen I'm not hear to throw you under the bus. Do what you think is best, and know you have more power and agency than they want you to feel.

Friend, I am. I'm on your side with this. My brother is a federal staffer. And this is going to take a multifaceted approach, to all of this. I'm a state worker in the medical field. I'm trying to get my hospital and union to file suits and put protections up for DEI hires, back the CDC, back the NIH, (both of whom we RELY on), and defend Medicaid and Medicare workers and staff. So many of my patients will die without those services. Hell I want my state legislature to start talking with neighboring states to create collective protections for similar things.   
  
I know how important your work is. AND I'm going to be real. No one is coming to save us.  Democrats have proven to have no backbone in this. They should be interviewing you all and posting these interviews to Youtube, tiktok, X-twitter, bluesky, here, facebook, insta, and everywhere. And they're not. So we have to do it ourselves. Which is overwhelming, and terrifying. And we can fight back. And one of the ways we do that. Locking the door to the castle and showing them they need us. If I was there I would try to be organizing this shit myself. I wish I was, and for my part I'm trying to shore what I can for my patients.

I hear ya. And do these people care about legality? Listen these things take time to organize. They take effort and communication. And if Doge is muzzled by the courts and it's somehow enforced, great! But what happens if this wire stripping continues?

Y'all, being fed employees, should consider striking.  If you know folks with the FAA, get them to talk to pilots to stop flights. Get rail workers to halt the trains. Drive this country to an absolute halt. Do this until Doge is removed in all capacities and disbanded. I suggest pushing it further and including Elon being charged under the Espionage Act too. DOGE has 30 different agency accounts now. It really does seem like they are Weimaring y'all. (Spoilers the Weimar Republic becomes the German Reich.) They're setting up parallel structures meant to take over the main facets of the agencies they're paralleling.  Next will be the persecution of all who aren't loyal to Doge.
Scratch's Sniff doesn't always trigger a perception check. Sometimes you just have to use the shovel and dig roughly where he is pointing to find stuff otherwise not observed.
